author: Cinna Davis
statement: A single packet with an affine row table modulo two and exactly-one-hot column support cannot realize taper node residues for any 1<=u<=a; allowing zero input gives a Boolean counterexample at u=1 and precision one.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the all-size proof
Higher-precision constructions with zero input or nonlinear row tables
Compatibility with actual balanced packing and full SAT cost
